caption: The drawing depicts a doll with a pale grey face and hands, rosy red cheeks, and black hair combed into two ringlets on either side of the head. The doll is wearing a dress with a full, wide skirt that reaches to the doll’s ankles, colored in light cream with horizontal grey stripes and a decorative hem. The bodice of the dress has puffed short sleeves, and the lower arms are covered with brown sleeves or gloves. Around the waist is a sash or belt, and the neckline is wide and gathered. The doll's legs are clad in white stockings with pink detailing near the top and black shoes with pointed toes. The background of the image is plain and unadorned, colored in a light cream shade.
title: Doll - "Ann Blairs"
